'''Futbolo Klubas Riteriai''', also known as '''FK Riteriai''' or as '''Riteriai''', is a Lithuanian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Vilnius]]. Until 21 February 2019, the club was based in [[Trakai]] and was known as '''FK Trakai'''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Oficialu. "Trakai" tampa "Riteriais" |url=http://fkriteriai.lt/2019/02/oficialu-trakai-tampa-riteriais/ |website=fkriteriai.lt |access-date=6 March 2019 |language=lt-LT |date=19 February 2019}}</ref> The team won the 2024 [[I Lyga]] and earned promotion to the [[A Lyga]] after a one-year absence.

''Riteriai,'' meaning "Knights" in Lithuanian, has volt green and dark blue as its team colors, previously yellow and blue before 2019. The club plays at the [[LFF Stadium]] in [[Vilnius]], which has a capacity of 5,067."}}
